notes.title: April 23 Update - 4 New Professions
notes.content:
[h1]New Professions[/h1]
We've introduced four stunning new professions, each with unique core mechanics and exclusive cards:
[list]
[*] [h2]Elf[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472322/ec466388893e314b8355d2fbdad02928c2484c78.png[/img]
[*] [h2]Mage[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472322/608dcddeb5a5a3f522914639d75ca55bb25d2513.png[/img]
[*] [h2]Commander[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472322/af9b22c98c07e99c9f73edae0aca3493258cf343.png[/img]
[*] [h2]Vampire[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472322/1c31f6d8316405b2b1cf30006468b4b0f5127a54.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Faction System[/h1]
[list]
[*] Alliance Mechanic: Players can choose to ally with other professions, unlocking their exclusive cards to add to your deck.
[*] Strategic Depth: Allied cards bring fresh tactical options but dilute your core deck, requiring careful balance of risk and reward.
[*] Inspiration: The faction system draws inspiration from 9 Kings.
[/list]
[h1]Future Plans[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Professions: Nightmare, Bishop, and Mechanical Vanguard.
[*] Offline PvP: Implement competitive offline battles.
[/list]

We know the current version may have bugs and imperfections. Your feedback is invaluable! If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please reach out to me via [url=https://space.bilibili.com/266743339?spm_id_from=333.1007.0.0]Bilibili [/url] or leave feedback in the comment.
